official_title: National Housing Development Authority Act Amendment
raw_text:
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-
Short
title.
This Act may be cited as the National Housing Deve-
lopment Authority (Amendment) Act, No. 20 of 1988.

2. The following new section is hereby inserted
immediately after section 73 of the National Housing
Development Authority Act, No. 17 of 1979 (hereinafter
referred to as "the principal enactment") and shall have
effect as section 73A of the principal enactment :-

of new
section 73A
in Act
No. 17 of
1979.

the
Authority of
all assets
&c., of the
Department
of National
Housing.
(a) assets (including immovable property)
vested in the Department
of
National Housing
the day
immediately preceding the appointed
date; and
on
(b) contracts and agreements entered
into, by or with, the Department of
National Housing and subsisting on
the day immediately preceding the
appointed date,
as are specified in an Order made by the
Minister and published in the Gazette, shall
be transferred to and vest in, the Authority
with effect from the appointed date.".
